notes.title: Remake Question + Changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have been working on the remake the past week and a bit, and I would like to say that I am really liking how it's going!

I just wanted to let you all know a few changes, and please let me know what you think.

So I am planning on changing the name of the game(If steam allows me to) when I re-do the store page once the update is out.
Also the story will be different as I have thought of many better ways of doing things etc!

I also wanted to ask, would you guys rather me create a whole new store page and call it "The Entity: Remake" etc or update on this appid? For information anyone that already owns the game would get the remake for free anyway, but just want to get your input on it as a new store page would create a lot more traffic to the page, but at the same time if I created a remake to make it fair, I would deactivated this store page afterwards, so please let me know!

Thank you!

notes.title: Remake Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to give you all an update on the remake. 

Now that my game Unknown Presence is out, I am spending a bit of time fixing up issues and added things to that game, but once that is completed I will continue work on this remake.

I don't have an exact time frame yet but I will be sure to let you all know a release date once I have done more work on it.

If you have any suggestions on what you would like to see, please write them below and I will see what I can do!

Thank you

notes.title: Remake Update (New Info)
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Quick update about the remake, I said that I was hoping to release the update sometime last month/this month. As of right now that won't happen unfortunately, due mainly to development on my other game as it is in the last stages and I am needing to work on it everyday. 
[b]Also, in the remake I have decided to completely remake the house, as in a whole different layout with new stuff etc so that is taking some extra time!
[/b]
Something I think everyone will love though, is that with this new house it is going to allow you to also go outside into the houses front and backyard which I feel like is going to be a large positive addition to the game which I hope you will all love! :)

In addition to that I am also using a new AI system for the AI components in the game. This new AI system is much more complex than the games original AI system, which should allow for better interactions with the AI in the game.

[b]Thank you all so much for your patience so far, I am not trying to rush this update so I hope you all understand why it may take longer than first thought![/b]

notes.title: Remake Information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've got an update on the remake for you all! 
I have been working on it quite a lot recently and have been making really really good progress, as of now I am planning on releasing the remake update sometime next month (February).

Please note that once I release the remake all of the screenshots, trailers etc will no longer be displayed due to them not being an accurate representation of the game, I will have to change the system requirements and I will be re-working, changing adding and deleting achievements.

Once the remake is out I would really really appreciate it if anyone that has reviewed/hasn't reviewed the game to go and give it a go and update/add a review as I would love to see what people think to the updated version!

I'll post some new screenshots soon, probably when I announced the exact release date of the remake! 

I hope that you're all excited! :)

notes.title: Remake?
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been quite sometime since I have updated this game and I wanted to ask, would any of your be interested if I did a bit of a remake for this game?

As since this game is so old, I have progressed in my game development ability and would like this game to reflect that.
The remake would just be an update and wouldn't cost any extra. I am just wanting to gauge if there would be any interest in this or not.

Thank You! :)

notes.title: Price Change & Explanation
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to let you know that we will be changing the price of The Entity as soon as it is approved from $4.99USD to $3.99USD.

We are sorry we haven't been doing any updates for The Entity, but you will see why soon. We will see if we can do one more update is anything is needing fixing, but we are not sure if we will do another as we are working on something else and we are an extremely small team with limited time.

Thank you,
Ragdoll Inc :)

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've got a special update for you today for Halloween! Here are the patch notes;

notes.title: DLC Update V 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the first official patch for The Entity: Returning Home. We have tried to fix most things people have said they have found so far. Here are the patch notes: 

- Main menu button is not working when prompted at the end of game.
- Fixed an issue where you could pick both options by moving far enough away at the end of DLC. 
- Fixed a bug where you could get the achievement "First Step" earlier than supposed too. 
- Fixed an issue where the achievements "Half-Way There", "Never To Return", and "Power items" couldn't be achieved. 
- Minor texture tweaks in the hell scene. 

Regards: Ragdoll Inc
